title: When the Extraction Wakes
author: August Iversen
blurb: Vesper Galloway, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
